Featuring 1100ccs of diesel torque, the Renegade Diesel zero turn lawn mower delivers pure, long-lasting, brute force performance. It packs a combination of top-of-the-line comfort, durability, and cutting-edge innovation that sets it apart from any other commercial grade zero turn mower on the turf.

Engine Options

Dimensions

  • Cutting Widths – 61″
  • Weight – 1,862 lbs.
  • Overall Height / Length – 51″/91″
  • Chute Up / Chute Down Width – 63.5″/75.5″

  • Suspension – Patented 3-Link Rear Trailing Arm Suspension with Patented Front Independent Suspension

      Dimensions

      • Cutting Widths: 6100 – 61″; 7200 – 72″
      • Weight: 6100 – 1,628 lbs.; 7200 – 1,693 lbs.

      • Chute Up / Chute Down Width: 6100 – 63.5″/75.5″; 7200 – 74.5″/86.5″“

      • Rear Tires/Front Tires – 26×12-12 Reaper® / 15×6-6 Smooth No Flat Front
      • Fuel – 13 Gallons, Unleaded Gasoline
      • Ground Speed (Forward) – Up To 13 mph

                      The Revolt Stand-On Zero Turn Mower is engineered for improved performance and usability in every way, from operator ease-of-use to durability on the turf. With greater visibility from the shorter frame and curved I-Beam front fork support, plus larger rear tires, the Revolt Stand-On Commercial Zero Turn Mower boasts a lower center of gravity making it one of the most maneuverable and balanced stand-on mowers around.

                          The Revolt Mower has been completely redesigned and improved in every way.

                          Although we’ve made it more compact, the Revolt delivers bigger performance in every way. Along with enhanced power, it also offers improved operator comfort, ease of use, and long-lasting durability.

                          A redesigned, shorter frame and curved I-Beam front fork support improve visibility, giving operators a clearer view and better control while cutting.

                          We’ve also upgraded to larger rear tires and repositioned the fuel tank to the center of the machine. This design improves balance and maneuverability by allowing the operator to stand directly between the rear tires, lowering the center of gravity. The result is exceptional stability and control—making the Revolt one of the most balanced and maneuverable stand-on mowers in the industry.

                          While others may struggle to keep up, the compact and steady Revolt is built to handle the job with confidence.
